items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Challenge for MIN: The only trade-eligible players now are Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert, Jaden McDaniels, Donte DiVincenzo, Joan Beringer & Terrence Shannon Jr.

LaMelo Ball & Josh Green can be traded by themselves now or aggregated on Sept. 10.

Waive-and-stretch for Green = $14M < 2nd apron.

items.title: [Charania] BREAKING: Jonathan Kuminga has agreed to a two-year, $13 million deal with the Minnesota Timberwolves, plus a player option, agent Aaron Turner tells ESPN. Kuminga will be a starter alongside Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball, Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert on the West contender.
